# Paris Digest

> > Comprehensive travel guide to Paris, covering top attractions like the Eiffel Tower, Louvre, Versailles, Champs-Élysées, and Montmartre with practical visitor information.

Paris Digest provides detailed guides for tourists visiting Paris and France, including museum guides, restaurant recommendations, shopping districts, transportation tips, and day trips. The site covers essential landmarks, cultural experiences, and practical travel planning for visitors exploring the City of Light.

## Museums & Cultural Attractions

- [Centre Pompidou. Famous works. Picasso paintings](https://www.parisdigest.com/monument/centre-pompidou.htm): Centre Pompidou modern art museum with Picasso, Chagall, Matisse collections
- [Louvre French Crown jewels Paris. Facts. History. Visit.](https://www.parisdigest.com/museums/louvre-crown-jewels.htm): French Crown Jewels in Louvre's Galerie d'Apollon, Le Régent diamond
- [Le Panthéon in Paris. Facts and visits. Panthéon metro stop.](https://www.parisdigest.com/monument/pantheon.htm): Le Panthéon monument: French mausoleum, Left Bank landmark, metro access
- [Air and Space Museum Paris in Le Bourget. Historic planes.](https://www.parisdigest.com/museums/air-and-space-museum.htm): Air and Space Museum at Le Bourget Airport with historic aircraft collection
- [Paris technology museum. Visit Musée des Arts et Métiers, the Paris Technology museum.](https://www.parisdigest.com/museums/paris_technology_museum.htm): Musée des Arts et Métiers: technology & science museum, historic inventions
- [Musée de Cluny, the Paris museum of the Middle Ages.](https://www.parisdigest.com/museums/musee-de-cluny-paris.htm): Musée de Cluny medieval museum: Lady with Unicorn tapestries, Roman baths
